rows.label: The Court of Final Appeal
rows.interpretation: CFA ground-contact vertices agree with source/current ground. 2,592 native vertices lie above tabular top 23 m; the 99th percentile height is 38.8 m; the 44.589 m maximum comprises 24 vertices over a narrow 0.307 × 0.312 m central feature. This is consistent with detailed dome and finial geometry rather than an isolated outlier, pending browser silhouette confirmation. Keep the native dome/finial height; no vertical scaling.
